title: Destination check: wrong Postgres password fails and is not echoed
summary: Checks a postgres destination twice with a wrong password, once in URL form and once in key=value form. Both must fail at stage connect, and neither response may contain the password.

steps.title: Check with the wrong password in URL form
steps.explain: The real destination check the console calls before saving a destination.

steps.title: URL form: ok is false
steps.explain: A wrong password must be refused.

steps.title: URL form: stage is connect
steps.explain: The login is the connect stage.

steps.title: URL form: message mentions the password
steps.explain: The user must be told to check the credentials.

steps.title: URL form: password absent from the response
steps.explain: The wrong password must never be returned.

steps.title: Check with the wrong password in key=value form
steps.explain: The real destination check the console calls before saving a destination.

steps.title: key=value form: ok is false
steps.explain: A wrong password must be refused.

steps.title: key=value form: stage is connect
steps.explain: The login is the connect stage.

steps.title: key=value form: password absent from the response
steps.explain: The wrong password must never be returned.
